source_refs.note: Unnumbered topic Identifying Business Opportunities under 9.4 as printed (PDF 131-132, printed 127-128).

blocks.text: Identifying business opportunities means finding problems in society that can be solved through products or services. Entrepreneurs observe daily life to understand customer needs and market demands. Technology helps in discovering new opportunities such as online education, e-commerce, and digital services. Successful entrepreneurs focus on solving real-world problems in innovative ways. In Pakistan, areas like agriculture, healthcare, and education provide many opportunities for digital business ideas.

blocks.alt: Tree diagram. The top box, Technology-Based Solutions, branches by arrows to four boxes: Education (E-learning), Healthcare (Telemedicine), Agriculture (Smart farming) and Business (Digital payments).

blocks.text: The printed Figure 9.4 hangs Business under Healthcare, with an arrow from Healthcare. The text names four separate areas, so Business is a fourth branch of Technology-Based Solutions, as drawn above.
